diagnosis: Upgrade occurred mid-cycle, so INV-88213 combines a prorated credit for unused time on the previous plan with a charge for the Business plan; the first invoice total therefore differs from the Business list price. No dispute or entitlement issue is indicated.
reply: Thanks for flagging this. Your upgrade took effect partway through the billing cycle, so the first invoice after an upgrade isn't a flat plan charge. It combines two things: a prorated credit for the unused portion of your previous plan, and a charge for the Business plan (proration line shows as a credit followed by the new plan charge). Because of that, the total on this first invoice can differ from the Business plan price shown on our pricing page — this applies to the first invoice only, and later invoices should bill at the standard plan price. If you'd like INV-88213 reviewed line by line, let us know the specific line you're questioning and the amount you expected, and we can look into it further.
